skills.name: Metal Oni Club
skills.description: Attacks enemies with a Metal Oni Club. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Enemy Skill Resistance -30% (6 sec)

skills.name: Oni Flash Lightning
skills.description: Gathers lightning in the club. Good effects on self and surrounding allies.  *Skill Evade Rate +50% (6 sec) *Reflects 200% of incoming skill damage as physical damage (6 sec) *Reflects 200% of incoming skill damage as magic damage (6 sec)

abilities.name: Stone Cold
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't be turned against their allies  in stages with the Siren Song obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Skill Barrier 2
abilities.description: Continuously provides a barrier that greatly protects against Skill Damage. - The Skill Barrier disappears after blocking Skill Damage 1 time and is reapplied 1 second later. - The Skill Barrier remains intact when Skill Damage is reduced to 0 through invincibility. - Boss, Guardian, and special type enemies' Skill Damage cannot be blocked.
